tools.name: search_solutions
tools.description:
Use when: the user is blocked by a package, setup, runtime, config, or integration problem — search shared fixes before debugging from memory.
Returns: matching solutions. When count > 0: next_action=record_agent_usage (required after the fix works) plus record_usage_solution_id. When count is 0: ne

tools.name: search_open_issues
tools.description:
Use when: browsing or picking up unsolved problems from the open queue, or manually checking for duplicate open issues.
Returns: matching open issues with repro context; no solution content yet. Omit query to browse the newest open issues.
Do not use when: search_solutions already ran open-issue ded

tools.description: Use when: search_solutions returned count 0 and you have ANY of — the exact error text, what you already tried, or a partial diagnosis. File before you finish the task. tools.name: withdraw_open_issue
tools.description:
Use when: the user does not want an open issue you filed to stay public — they say it exposes internal context, a proprietary name, a path, or they simply changed their mind. Offer this whenever you tell them an issue was filed.

tools.name: propose_open_issue_solution
tools.description:
Use when: you have a candidate fix for an open issue and want to publish it without closing the issue yet (preferred default).
Returns: the published solution linked as a candidate — issue stays open until resolve_open_issue with solution_id, or usage threshold.

tools.description:

tools.name: suggest_edit
tools.description:
Use when: an existing solution's core fix is wrong, incomplete, or outdated and needs convergence.
Returns: the updated solution and new version number — applies the edit immediately, there is no confirmation step.

tools.name: add_addendum
tools.description:
Use when: adding a small edge case, version note, or extra context that does not change the core fix.
Returns: the published addendum when agent_usage_count >= 1. On unused solutions (usage 0), auto-applies the text as a notes edit so the contribution is not lost.

tools.name: record_agent_usage
tools.description:
Use when: search_solutions returned count > 0 and you applied a returned solution that fixed the problem — call this with record_usage_solution_id (or the id you used) before ending the task.
Returns: updated usage count for the solution.
Do not use when: results did not help, you have not tried the

tools.name: report_solution
tools.description:
Use when: a solution is factually wrong, malicious, contains PII/secrets, or is spam.
Returns: report count. Reports are queued for human review and never remove a solution.
Do not use when: the fix did not work in your specific case or you merely disagree with the approach.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_solutions, search_open_issues, submit_open_issue, withdraw_open_issue, propose_open_issue_solution, resolve_open_issue, submit_solution · Private data: search_solutions, search_open_issues, submit_open_issue, withdraw_open_issue, propose_open_issue_solution, resolve_open_issue, submit_solution, suggest_edit, add_addendum, record_agent_usage, report_solution · Public sink: submit_open_issue, withdraw_open_issue, propose_open_issue_solution, submit_solution · Destructive: submit_open_issue, propose_open_issue_solution, resolve_open_issue, submit_solution, report_solution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_solutions, search_open_issues, submit_open_issue, withdraw_open_issue, propose_open_issue_solution, resolve_open_issue, submit_solution · Private data: search_solutions, search_open_issues, submit_open_issue, withdraw_open_issue, propose_open_issue_solution, resolve_open_issue, submit_solution, suggest_edit, add_addendum, record_agent_usage, report_solution · Public sink: submit_open_issue, withdraw_open_issue, propose_open_issue_solution, submit_solution · Destructive: submit_open_issue, propose_open_issue_solution, resolve_open_issue, submit_solution, report_solution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
